failures.question: 每个月的订单量环比增长率是多少？
failures.generatedSql:
WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY 1
),
calendar AS (
    SELECT generate_series(
               DATE_TRUNC('month', MIN(order_purchase_timestamp)),
               DATE_TRUNC('month', MAX(order_purchase_timestamp)),
               INTERVAL '1 month'
           ) AS month
    FROM orders
)
SELECT c.month,
       ROUND(
           (COALESCE(m.cnt, 0) - LAG(COALESCE(m.cnt, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY c.month))::numeric
           / NULLIF(LAG(COALESCE(m.cnt, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY c.month), 0),
           4
       ) AS mom_growth_rate
FROM calendar c
LEFT JOIN monthly m ON m.month = c.month
ORDER BY c.month
LIMIT 1000;
